title: tephrosia eriocarpa var. genuina
intro: Tephrosia eriocarpa var. genuina, commonly known as a species of flowering plant in the pea family Fabaceae, is native to tropical Africa. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Tephrosia eriocarpa var. genuina include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides. Research has identified the presence of isoflavones, flavanones, and coumarins as the primary bioactive constituents of this plant, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
